summary: @nayrbgo No, and nefarious probably a little strong, but it is self-serving. Many #cs4all programs use number of comp sci AP tests as a variable, while the publishers of the test fund #cs4all programs, out of altruistic but helpful goals.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @nayrbgo No, and nefarious probably a little strong, but it is self-serving. Many #cs4all programs use number of comp sci AP tests as a variable, while the publishers of the test fund #cs4all programs, out of altruistic but helpful goals.
